# appdimens-roku

> AppDimens for Roku (BrightScript / SceneGraph): responsive sizes for the 10-foot UI — global tokens `sdp(96)`, `asdp(24)` (like `sdp(16)` on the Web) or `ad = AppDimens()`, `ad.sdp(96)`, `ad.fontSize(32)`, `ad.safeRect("title")`, `ad.resolve("asdpa", 24)`, `ad.dimen("16hdpLw")`. Reads the manifest's ui_resolutions (FHD/HD/SD coordinate spaces); modes reference (px at 1920×1080 → coordinates, default), tv (Android TV 960×540 dp) and pixel. Custom strategies with the shared JSON document (`AppDimens_LoadStrategies`, `cdp(16, "brand")`, `csp(14, "brand")`, `"16cdp-brand"`). Version 3.2.0.

- [README](README.md) · [Guide](docs/GUIDE.md) · [Custom](docs/CUSTOM.md) · [Skill](skills/appdimens-roku/SKILL.md)
- Files: `source/AppDimens.brs`, `source/AppDimensTokens.brs` (generated by tools/gen_tokens.py), `source/AppDimensCustom.brs`
- Tests: `npm test` (brs-engine), `npx bsc --project bsconfig.json`
- Hub: https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens

Family (same tokens and math): appdimens-dynamic (Android), appdimens-sdps/ssps (XML), appdimens-kmp, appdimens-ios, appdimens-flutter, appdimens-react-native, appdimens-web, appdimens-net-binding (.NET), appdimens-qt, appdimens-gtk, appdimens-lvgl, appdimens-roku, appdimens-py, appdimens-games — https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens · agent skills: https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens-skills
